STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: rtlpp_06930_combined.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: rtlpp_06930_combined.v · Open raw
module rtlpp_06930 (
    input  [9:0] address,
    input  [3:0] byteenable,
    input        chipselect,
    input        clk,
    input        clken,
    input        write,
    input  [31:0] writedata,
    output [31:0] readdata
);

    wire wren;
    assign wren = chipselect & write;

    reg [31:0] mem_array [1023:0];
    reg [31:0] read_data_reg;

    assign readdata = read_data_reg;

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (clken) begin
            if (wren) begin
                if (byteenable[0])
                    mem_array[address][7:0] <= writedata[7:0];
                if (byteenable[1])
                    mem_array[address][15:8] <= writedata[15:8];
                if (byteenable[2])
                    mem_array[address][23:16] <= writedata[23:16];
                if (byteenable[3])
                    mem_array[address][31:24] <= writedata[31:24];
            end
            read_data_reg <= mem_array[address];
        end
    end

endmodule
